endorsements.name: Noam Trobishi
endorsements.label: CUDA've done better - Hacking Nvidia GPUs for container-escape and privilege escalation
endorsements.description: CUDA've done better - Hacking Nvidia GPUs for container-escape and privilege escalation. We found and exploited a UAF in the NVIDIA Linux kernel module that allows us to escape NVIDIA containers and gain root access on the host. We'll show novel exploitation techniques: bypass kernel heap mitigations, deterministically win races by abusing rw_semaphore , and execute code on the kernel without ever jumping anywhere (by writing directly to physical memory).
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 34
